metadata.title: [FEATURE][UI]: Add padding to input, select and textarea HTML elements for consistency
metadata.author: claudia-gray

description: Signed-off-by: Claudia Gray ## 🔗 Related Issue Closes https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/3657 --- ## 📝 Summary This PR addresses the inconsistent and not-so-aesthetic padding in all input, select and textarea HTML elements across all sections in the UI Admin Panel. px-1.5 -> px-3 py-2 --- ## 🏷️ Type of Change - [ ] Bug fix - [x] Feature / Enhancement - [ ] Documentation - [ ] Refactor - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling) - [ ] Other (describe below) --- ## Fixed By Using suggested fix mentioned in original issue: https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/3657 --- ## 🧪 Verification Passed all tests ran by file here on slack: https://ibm-cloud.slack.com/archives/C0A71H6HMAN/p1772704889538949 They are: **Format** - autoflake · isort · black **Unit Test** - flake8 · bandit · interrogate · doctest · test · lint-web · pylint · verify **Coverage** - make coverage results in 99% --- ## 📓 Images ### Original Styling: ### Updated Styling (Few examples of many)

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
Thanks for the padding consistency fix, @claudia-gray! The `px-1.5` → `px-3 py-2` standardization across form inputs looks good.

I rebased onto `main` (clean, no conflicts) and fixed a few issues introduced by the find-and-replace:

**Bugs fixed:**
1. **Duplicate Tailwind classes** (16 instances in `admin.py` + `admin.html`) — elements that already had `px-3 py-2` in their class string got a second `px-3 py-2` prepended, e.g. `mt-1 px-3 py-2 block w-full px-3 py-2 border...`. Removed the duplicates.
2. **Conflicting `py-2 py-0.5`** on the Copy ID button and Inactive/Requires Token status badges in `admin.js` — these are small inline elements (`text-xs`, `rounded`), not form inputs. The `py-2` conflicted with the intentional `py-0.5`. Reverted to original `px-1.5 py-0.5`.
3. **Tag filter pills** (`updateAvailableTags`) changed from `px-2 py-1` to `px-3 py-2` — these are small `rounded-full` pill buttons, not form inputs. Reverted.

All 15,019 tests pass. LGTM ✅

commits.message:
fix(ui): remove duplicate and conflicting Tailwind classes from padding PR

- Remove duplicate `px-3 py-2` in form inputs that already had `px-3 py-2`
  later in the class string (admin.py: 9 instances, admin.html: 7 instances)
- Fix conflicting `py-2 py-0.5` on Copy ID button and status badges in
  admin.js — these are small inline elements, not form inputs
- Revert tag filter pill padding from `px-3 py-2` back to `px-2 py-1` as
  these are small rounded-full pills, not form input elements

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
